Pot-Sticker Soup
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 5:33am

Ingredients




1 bag frozen pot stickers
2 cans chicken broth
Chopped green onions

Preparation

1 Using a double-boiler, which is also a steamer, place pot stickers in the top steamer section and chicken broth in the bottom section. While these are heating - it takes 7 to 8 minutes - chop some green onions. 2 When the pot stickers are done, place 4 or 5 in each bowl, pour hot chicken broth over them and sprinkle chopped green onions on top. Enjoy a bowl of pot sticker soup! 3 If I have leftovers, such as rice or noodles, cooked chicken or cooked vegetables, I add them also.
